idea: Why a toilet may keep running
title: The Real Reason Behind That Constant Toilet Running Sound
description: A running toilet isn't just annoying; it can waste hundreds of gallons of water every day. The problem usually stems from a few key components inside the toilet tank. The most common culprit is a worn-out or misaligned flapper seal that allows water to continuously leak into the bowl. Another frequent cause is an improperly adjusted float level or a failing fill valve, which prevents the tank from shutting off the water supply once full. Inspecting the lift chain for tangles can also resolve minor issues. If replacing basic tank parts does not solve the problem, a qualified plumber can accurately diagnose and repair the system.
